svg.aria-label: Exclusive Use Lane Line road marking
svg.title: RM9 — Exclusive Use Lane Line
svg.desc: Drawn to specification, not traced. Source: SARTSM Vol 1 §7.2.13, §7.2.21; NRTR 2000 reg 289. Broken YELLOW line minimum 150 mm wide, used together with an exclusive-use word or symbol marking (RM17).
